summary.en: A festival main stage: a wide LED wall with a moving colour field, a stack of dark glass cubes with lit frames above a low black deck, light trays, line arrays and a cyan LED line. 43.6 m tall and 160 m wide at full size; the height scales the whole stage.
summary.ar: مسرح مهرجان رئيسي: جدار LED عريض بألوان متحركة، وفوق منصة سوداء منخفضة هرم مقلوب من مكعبات زجاجية داكنة بإطارات مضيئة، مع صواني إضاءة وسماعات معلقة وخط LED سماوي. ارتفاعه 43.6 م وعرضه 160 م بالحجم الكامل، والارتفاع يغيّر حجم المسرح كله.

defaults.note: height: the file's box, 160.4 x 43.6 x 37 m (a 160 x 34 m LED wall, the cube stack's crown above it). The runtime scales each instance by height / 43.6, and the collider with it. accent: materials.js's cyan (0.1, 0.85, 1.0). show stands in for the song's `screens` uniform (1: the screens on). Draws: loadStage draws one mesh per material (11); here stage.glb is models/big-beast-stage.glb with its eleven meshes joined by tools/glb-join.mjs (vertex data unchanged, node transforms baked, the material index written to the vertex colour alpha) and one preset branching on it, so 1 draw per preset. lod1 is the same file as lod0 (no lighter version is made: 19,060 triangles is inside the Phone budget). Not carried over: the 26 light markers (MH, ST, BL empties: moving heads, strobes, blinders), the IMAG feed and the rendered r187 galaxy / tornado on the wall (they need the music-video app's second camera and song clock), the haze. The wall shows led.js's slow colour field.

made_by: 3DPLAT (Blender by script, models/big-beast-stage/src/stage.py in Kr4T/3DPLAT, shaped after press photos of the Soundstorm 2024 Big Beast stage; look in TSL, materials.js)
